We were coming from Doyle, with no possibility of having lunch (restaurant closed)...we opted for this station and were truly surprised by how good the lunch was and the service was unbeatable. It's definitely on my list for future stops to enjoy the park on the property...greetings to the staff for your attention, we will definitely be back!
